### [How is white-label production priced?](https://seowind.io/pricing/\#)

Fixed per-article pricing based on volume and number of clients. We customize during your initial call. Per-article pricing includes research, writing, editing, revisions, and delivery. No hidden fees.

### [How do SEO Marketing Services work?](https://seowind.io/pricing/\#)

We act as your outsourced SEO team. After an initial audit, we build a strategy and execute monthly – content, optimization, reporting. Retainers start at $3,000/mo based on scope.

### [Why is white-label more expensive than platform access?](https://seowind.io/pricing/\#)

Platform access gives you tools. White-label includes the full workflow: research, briefs, AI drafting, human editing, QA, and delivery. You’re buying finished content, not a tool.

### [Is there a minimum commitment?](https://seowind.io/pricing/\#)

For white-label: We start with a pilot (typically 5-10 articles). No long-term contract required.

For SEO Services: 3-month minimum to see results.

### [What languages does SEOwind support?](https://seowind.io/pricing/\#)

Currently, SEOwind covers over 180 locations around the globe in the following languages: English, Czech, Dutch, French, German, Indonesian, Italian, Polish, Portuguese, Slovak, Spanish and Swedish.

### [What is the refund/cancellation policy?](https://seowind.io/pricing/\#)

For Platform Access: You have 3 days to to make sure it’s the right fit. You can also cancel your subscription anytime.
